        "contents": "With OTEL enabled Codex emits the following event types (in addition to the\nmetadata above):\n\n- &#96;codex.conversation_starts&#96;\n  - &#96;provider_name&#96;\n  - &#96;reasoning_effort&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;reasoning_summary&#96;\n  - &#96;context_window&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;max_output_tokens&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;auto_compact_token_limit&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;approval_policy&#96;\n  - &#96;sandbox_policy&#96;\n  - &#96;mcp_servers&#96; (comma-separated list)\n  - &#96;active_profile&#96; (optional)\n- &#96;codex.api_request&#96;\n  - &#96;attempt&#96;\n  - &#96;duration_ms&#96;\n  - &#96;http.response.status_code&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;error.message&#96; (failures)\n- &#96;codex.sse_event&#96;\n  - &#96;event.kind&#96;\n  - &#96;duration_ms&#96;\n  - &#96;error.message&#96; (failures)\n  - &#96;input_token_count&#96; (responses only)\n  - &#96;output_token_count&#96; (responses only)\n  - &#96;cached_token_count&#96; (responses only, optional)\n  - &#96;reasoning_token_count&#96; (responses only, optional)\n  - &#96;tool_token_count&#96; (responses only)\n- &#96;codex.user_prompt&#96;\n  - &#96;prompt_length&#96;\n  - &#96;prompt&#96; (redacted unless &#96;log_user_prompt = true&#96;)\n- &#96;codex.tool_decision&#96;\n  - &#96;tool_name&#96;\n  - &#96;call_id&#96;\n  - &#96;decision&#96; (&#96;approved&#96;, &#96;approved_execpolicy_amendment&#96;, &#96;approved_for_session&#96;, &#96;denied&#96;, or &#96;abort&#96;)\n  - &#96;source&#96; (&#96;config&#96; or &#96;user&#96;)\n- &#96;codex.tool_result&#96;\n  - &#96;tool_name&#96;\n  - &#96;call_id&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;arguments&#96; (optional)\n  - &#96;duration_ms&#96; (execution time for the tool)\n  - &#96;success&#96; (&#96;\"true\"&#96; or &#96;\"false\"&#96;)\n  - &#96;output&#96;\n\nThese event shapes may change as we iterate.\n\n### Choosing an exporter\n\nSet &#96;otel.exporter&#96; to control where events go:\n\n- &#96;none&#96; – leaves instrumentation active but skips exporting. This is the\n  default.\n- &#96;otlp-http&#96; – posts OTLP log records to an OTLP/HTTP collector. Specify the\n  endpoint, protocol, and headers your collector expects:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n  [otel.exporter.\"otlp-http\"]\n  endpoint = \"https://otel.example.com/v1/logs\"\n  protocol = \"binary\"\n\n  [otel.exporter.\"otlp-http\".headers]\n  \"x-otlp-api-key\" = \"${OTLP_TOKEN}\"\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- &#96;otlp-grpc&#96; – streams OTLP log records over gRPC. Provide the endpoint and any\n  metadata headers:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n  [otel]\n  exporter = { otlp-grpc = {endpoint = \"https://otel.example.com:4317\",headers = { \"x-otlp-meta\" = \"abc123\" }}}",

OtelManager::responses_item_type(item),\n            ResponseEvent::OutputItemAdded(item) =&gt; OtelManager::responses_item_type(item),\n            ResponseEvent::Completed { .. } =&gt; \"completed\".into(),\n            ResponseEvent::OutputTextDelta(_) =&gt; \"text_delta\".into(),\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryDelta { .. } =&gt; \"reasoning_summary_delta\".into(),\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningContentDelta { .. } =&gt; \"reasoning_content_delta\".into(),\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryPartAdded { .. } =&gt; String {\n        match item {\n            ResponseItem::Message { role, .. } =&gt; format!(\"message_from_{role}\"),\n            ResponseItem::Reasoning { .. } =&gt; \"reasoning\".into(),\n            ResponseItem::LocalShellCall { .. } =&gt; String {\n    Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Millis, true)\n}",

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Diagnosing rustc execution failure**

The observed rustc path includes leading whitespace—likely from a carriage return or newline—causing the "program not found" error when run via cmd. This suggests environment variables or shell quoting introduce invisible characters interfering with execution. Next, I'll confirm the actual shell in use and try running the build in PowerShell or adjusting how environment vars are set to avoid corrupted paths.**Analyzing PowerShell quoting issues**

I've traced how single quotes in PowerShell preserve backslashes literally, causing escaped double quotes (`\"`) to be treated as literal characters, not escapes. This led to `$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"` being misinterpreted and a command-not-found error for `Stop`. Using single quotes outside and simple unescaped double quotes inside should fix the variable assignment without unintended expansions.**Refining PowerShell command quoting**

I'm preparing a PowerShell command wrapped in single quotes after -Command to prevent outer PS variable expansion, carefully escaping inner double quotes and backslashes for JSON embedding to avoid substitution issues. I'll test this quoting to ensure the build command runs correctly.</details></think>

Built-in defaults compiled into the binary so Codex works out-of-the-box.\\n//!   2. User-defined entries inside &amp;#96;~/.codex/config.toml&amp;#96; under the &amp;#96;model_providers&amp;#96;\\n//!      key. These override or extend the defaults at runtime.\\n\\nuse crate::CodexAuth;\\nuse crate::default_client::CodexRequestBuilder;\\nuse codex_app_server_protocol::AuthMode;\\nuse codex_client::CodexHttpClient;\\nuse serde::Deserialize;\\nuse serde::Serialize;\\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\\nuse std::env::VarError;\\nuse std::time::Duration;\\n\\nuse crate::error::EnvVarError;\\nconst DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS: u64 = 300_000;\\nconst DEFAULT_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 5;\\nconst DEFAULT_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 4;\\n/// Hard cap for user-configured &amp;#96;stream_max_retries&amp;#96;.\\nconst MAX_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 100;\\n/// Hard cap for user-configured &amp;#96;request_max_retries&amp;#96;.\\nconst MAX_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 100;\\n\\n/// Wire protocol that the provider speaks. Most third-party services only\\n/// implement the classic OpenAI Chat Completions JSON schema, whereas OpenAI\\n/// itself (and a handful of others) additionally expose the more modern\\n/// *Responses* API. The two protocols use different request/response shapes\\n/// and *cannot* be auto-detected at runtime, therefore each provider entry\\n/// must declare which one it expects.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\\n#[serde(rename_all = \\\"lowercase\\\")]\\npub enum WireApi {\\n    /// The Responses API exposed by OpenAI at &amp;#96;/v1/responses&amp;#96;.\\n    Responses,\\n\\n    /// Regular Chat Completions compatible with &amp;#96;/v1/chat/completions&amp;#96;.\\n    #[default]\\n    Chat,\\n}\\n\\n/// Serializable representation of a provider definition.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, PartialEq)]\\npub struct ModelProviderInfo {\\n    /// Friendly display name.\\n    pub name: String,\\n    /// Base URL for the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.\\n    pub base_url: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n    /// Environment variable that stores the user's API key for this provider.\\n    pub env_key: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Optional instructions to help the user get a valid value for the\\n    /// variable and set it.\\n    pub env_key_instructions: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Value to use with &amp;#96;Authorization: Bearer &amp;lt;token&amp;gt;&amp;#96; header. Use of this\\n    /// config is discouraged in favor of &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; for security reasons, but\\n    /// this may be necessary when using this programmatically.\\n    pub experimental_bearer_token: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Which wire protocol this provider expects.\\n    #[serde(default)]\\n    pub wire_api: WireApi,\\n\\n    /// Optional query parameters to append to the base URL.\\n    pub query_params: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Additional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where\\n    /// the (key, value) pairs are the header name and value.\\n    pub http_headers: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Optional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where the\\n    /// (key, value) pairs are the header name and _environment variable_ whose\\n    /// value should be used. If the environment variable is not set, or the\\n    /// value is empty, the header will not be included in the request.\\n    pub env_http_headers: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Maximum number of times to retry a failed HTTP request to this provider.\\n    pub request_max_retries: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Number of times to retry reconnecting a dropped streaming response before failing.\\n    pub stream_max_retries: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Idle timeout (in milliseconds) to wait for activity on a streaming response before treating\\n    /// the connection as lost.\\n    pub stream_idle_timeout_ms: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Does this provider require an OpenAI API Key or ChatGPT login token? If true,\\n    /// user is presented with login screen on first run, and login preference and token/key\\n    /// are stored in auth.json. If false (which is the default), login screen is skipped,\\n    /// and API key (if needed) comes from the \\\"env_key\\\" environment variable.\\n    #[serde(default)]\\n    pub requires_openai_auth: bool,\\n}\\n\\nimpl ModelProviderInfo {\\n    /// Construct a &amp;#96;POST&amp;#96; RequestBuilder for the given URL using the provided\\n    /// [&amp;#96;CodexHttpClient&amp;#96;] applying:\\n    ///   • provider-specific headers (static + env based)\\n    ///   • Bearer auth header when an API key is available.\\n    ///   • Auth token for OAuth.\\n    ///\\n    /// If the provider declares an &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; but the variable is missing/empty, returns an [&amp;#96;Err&amp;#96;] identical to the\\n    /// one produced by [&amp;#96;ModelProviderInfo::api_key&amp;#96;].\\n    pub async fn create_request_builder&amp;lt;'a&amp;gt;(\\n        &amp;amp;'a self,\\n        client: &amp;amp;'a CodexHttpClient,\\n        auth: &amp;amp;Option&amp;lt;CodexAuth&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; crate::error::Result&amp;lt;CodexRequestBuilder&amp;gt; {\\n        let effective_auth = if let Some(secret_key) = &amp;amp;self.experimental_bearer_token {\\n            Some(CodexAuth::from_api_key(secret_key))\\n        } else {\\n            match self.api_key() {\\n                Ok(Some(key)) =&amp;gt; Some(CodexAuth::from_api_key(&amp;amp;key)),\\n                Ok(None) =&amp;gt; auth.clone(),\\n                Err(err) =&amp;gt; {\\n                    if auth.is_some() {\\n                        auth.clone()\\n                    } else {\\n                        return Err(err);\\n                    }\\n                }\\n            }\\n        };\\n\\n        let url = self.get_full_url(&amp;amp;effective_auth);\\n\\n        let mut builder = client.post(url);\\n\\n        if let Some(auth) = effective_auth.as_ref() {\\n            builder = builder.bearer_auth(auth.get_token().await?);\\n        }\\n\\n        Ok(self.apply_http_headers(builder))\\n    }\\n\\n    fn get_query_string(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        self.query_params\\n            .as_ref()\\n            .map_or_else(String::new, |params| {\\n                let full_params = params\\n                    .iter()\\n                    .map(|(k, v)| format!(\\\"{k}={v}\\\"))\\n                    .collect::&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;_&amp;gt;&amp;gt;()\\n                    .join(\\\"&amp;amp;\\\");\\n                format!(\\\"?{full_params}\\\")\\n            })\\n    }\\n\\n    pub(crate) fn get_full_url(&amp;amp;self, auth: &amp;amp;Option&amp;lt;CodexAuth&amp;gt;) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        let default_base_url = if matches!(\\n            auth,\\n            Some(CodexAuth {\\n                mode: AuthMode::ChatGPT,\\n                ..\\n            })\\n        ) {\\n            \\\"https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex\\\"\\n        } else {\\n            \\\"https://api.openai.com/v1\\\"\\n        };\\n        let query_string = self.get_query_string();\\n        let base_url = self\\n            .base_url\\n            .clone()\\n            .unwrap_or(default_base_url.to_string());\\n\\n        match self.wire_api {\\n            WireApi::Responses =&amp;gt; format!(\\\"{base_url}/responses{query_string}\\\"),\\n            WireApi::Chat =&amp;gt; format!(\\\"{base_url}/chat/completions{query_string}\\\"),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    pub(crate) fn is_azure_responses_endpoint(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; bool {\\n        if self.wire_api != WireApi::Responses {\\n            return false;\\n        }\\n\\n        if self.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\\\"azure\\\") {\\n            return true;\\n        }\\n\\n        self.base_url\\n            .as_ref()\\n            .map(|base| matches_azure_responses_base_url(base))\\n            .unwrap_or(false)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Apply provider-specific HTTP headers (both static and environment-based)\\n    /// onto an existing [&amp;#96;CodexRequestBuilder&amp;#96;] and return the updated\\n    /// builder.\\n    fn apply_http_headers(&amp;amp;self, mut builder: CodexRequestBuilder) -&amp;gt; CodexRequestBuilder {\\n        if let Some(extra) = &amp;amp;self.http_headers {\\n            for (k, v) in extra {\\n                builder = builder.header(k, v);\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        if let Some(env_headers) = &amp;amp;self.env_http_headers {\\n            for (header, env_var) in env_headers {\\n                if let Ok(val) = std::env::var(env_var)\\n                    &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !val.trim().is_empty()\\n                {\\n                    builder = builder.header(header, val);\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n        builder\\n    }\\n\\n    /// If &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; is Some, returns the API key for this provider if present\\n    /// (and non-empty) in the environment. If &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; is required but\\n    /// cannot be found, returns an error.\\n    pub fn api_key(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; crate::error::Result&amp;lt;Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n        match &amp;amp;self.env_key {\\n            Some(env_key) =&amp;gt; {\\n                let env_value = std::env::var(env_key);\\n                env_value\\n                    .and_then(|v| {\\n                        if v.trim().is_empty() {\\n                            Err(VarError::NotPresent)\\n                        } else {\\n                            Ok(Some(v))\\n                        }\\n                    })\\n                    .map_err(|_| {\\n                        crate::error::CodexErr::EnvVar(EnvVarError {\\n                            var: env_key.clone(),\\n                            instructions: self.env_key_instructions.clone(),\\n                        })\\n                    })\\n            }\\n            None =&amp;gt; Ok(None),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective maximum number of request retries for this provider.\\n    pub fn request_max_retries(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; u64 {\\n        self.request_max_retries\\n            .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES)\\n            .min(MAX_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective maximum number of stream reconnection attempts for this provider.\\n    pub fn stream_max_retries(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; u64 {\\n        self.stream_max_retries\\n            .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES)\\n            .min(MAX_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective idle timeout for streaming responses.\\n    pub fn stream_idle_timeout(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; Duration {\\n        self.stream_idle_timeout_ms\\n            .map(Duration::from_millis)\\n            .unwrap_or(Duration::from_millis(DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS))\\n    }\\n    pub fn create_openai_provider() -&amp;gt; ModelProviderInfo {\\n        ModelProviderInfo {\\n            name: \\\"OpenAI\\\".into(),\\n            // Allow users to override the default OpenAI endpoint by\\n            // exporting &amp;#96;OPENAI_BASE_URL&amp;#96;. This is useful when pointing\\n            // Codex at a proxy, mock server, or Azure-style deployment\\n            // without requiring a full TOML override for the built-in\\n            // OpenAI provider.\\n            base_url: std::env::var(\\\"OPENAI_BASE_URL\\\")\\n                .ok()\\n                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()),\\n            env_key: None,\\n            env_key_instructions: None,\\n            experimental_bearer_token: None,\\n            wire_api: WireApi::Responses,\\n            query_params: None,\\n            http_headers: Some(\\n                [(\\\"version\\\".to_string(), env!(\\\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\\\").to_string())]\\n                    .into_iter()\\n                    .collect(),\\n            ),\\n            env_http_headers: Some(\\n                [\\n                    (\\n                        \\\"OpenAI-Organization\\\".to_string(),\\n                        \\\"OPENAI_ORGANIZATION\\\".to_string(),\\n                    ),\\n                    (\\\"OpenAI-Project\\\".to_string(), \\\"OPENAI_PROJECT\\\".to_string()),\\n                ]\\n                .into_iter()\\n                .collect(),\\n            ),\\n            // Use global defaults for retry/timeout unless overridden in config.toml.\\n            request_max_retries: None,\\n            stream_max_retries: None,\\n            stream_idle_timeout_ms: None,\\n            requires_openai_auth: true,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nconst DEFAULT_OLLAMA_PORT: u32 = 11434;\\n\\npub const BUILT_IN_OSS_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID: &amp;amp;str = \\\"oss\\\";\\n\\n/// Built-in default provider list.\\npub fn built_in_model_providers() -&amp;gt; HashMap&amp;lt;String, ModelProviderInfo&amp;gt; {\\n    use ModelProviderInfo as P;\\n\\n    // We do not want to be in the business of adjucating which third-party\\n    // providers are bundled with Codex CLI, so we only include the OpenAI and\\n    // open source (\\\"oss\\\") providers by default. Users are encouraged to add to\\n    // &amp;#96;model_providers&amp;#96; in config.toml to add their own providers.\\n    [\\n        (\\\"openai\\\", P::create_openai_provider()),\\n ModelProviderInfo {\\n    // These CODEX_OSS_ environment variables are experimental: we may\\n    // switch to reading values from config.toml instead.\\n    let codex_oss_base_url = match std::env::var(\\\"CODEX_OSS_BASE_URL\\\")\\n        .ok()\\n        .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty())\\n    {\\n        Some(url) =&amp;gt; url,\\n        None =&amp;gt; format!(\\n            \\\"http://localhost:{port}/v1\\\",\\n            port = std::env::var(\\\"CODEX_OSS_PORT\\\")\\n                .ok()\\n                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty())\\n                .and_then(|v| v.parse::&amp;lt;u32&amp;gt;().ok())\\n                .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_OLLAMA_PORT)\\n        ),\\n    };\\n\\n   name: \\\"gpt-oss\\\".into(),\\n        base_url: Some(base_url.into()),\\n        env_key: None,\\n        env_key_instructions: None,\\n        experimental_bearer_token: None,\\n        wire_api: WireApi::Chat,\\n        query_params: None,\\n        http_headers: None,\\n        env_http_headers: None,\\n        request_max_retries: None,\\n        stream_max_retries: None,\\n        stream_idle_timeout_ms: None,\\n        requires_openai_auth: false,\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nfn matches_azure_responses_base_url(base_url: &amp;amp;str) -&amp;gt; bool {\\n    let base = base_url.to_ascii_lowercase();\\n    const AZURE_MARKERS: [&amp;amp;str; 5] = [\\n        \\\"openai.azure.\\\",\\n        \\\"cognitiveservices.azure.\\\",\\n        \\\"aoai.azure.\\\",\\n        \\\"azure-api.\\\",\\n        \\\"azurefd.\\\",\\n    ];\\n    AZURE_MARKERS.iter().any(|marker| base.contains(marker))\\n}\\n\\n#[cfg(test)]\\nmod tests {\\n    use super::*;\\n    use                   "content": "  \"contentsAfterEdit\": \"//! Registry of model providers supported by Codex.\\n//!\\n//! Providers can be defined in two places:\\n//!   1. Built-in defaults compiled into the binary so Codex works out-of-the-box.\\n//!   2. User-defined entries inside &amp;#96;~/.codex/config.toml&amp;#96; under the &amp;#96;model_providers&amp;#96;\\n//!      key. These override or extend the defaults at runtime.\\n\\nuse crate::CodexAuth;\\nuse crate::default_client::CodexHttpClient;\\nuse crate::default_client::CodexRequestBuilder;\\nuse codex_app_server_protocol::AuthMode;\\nuse serde::Deserialize;\\nuse serde::Serialize;\\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\\nuse std::env::VarError;\\nuse std::time::Duration;\\n\\nuse crate::error::EnvVarError;\\nconst DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS: u64 = 300_000;\\nconst DEFAULT_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 5;\\nconst DEFAULT_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 4;\\n/// Hard cap for user-configured &amp;#96;stream_max_retries&amp;#96;.\\nconst MAX_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 100;\\n/// Hard cap for user-configured &amp;#96;request_max_retries&amp;#96;.\\nconst MAX_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES: u64 = 100;\\n\\n/// Wire protocol that the provider speaks. Most third-party services only\\n/// implement the classic OpenAI Chat Completions JSON schema, whereas OpenAI\\n/// itself (and a handful of others) additionally expose the more modern\\n/// *Responses* API. The two protocols use different request/response shapes\\n/// and *cannot* be auto-detected at runtime, therefore each provider entry\\n/// must declare which one it expects.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\\n#[serde(rename_all = \\\"lowercase\\\")]\\npub enum WireApi {\\n    /// The Responses API exposed by OpenAI at &amp;#96;/v1/responses&amp;#96;.\\n    Responses,\\n\\n    /// Regular Chat Completions compatible with &amp;#96;/v1/chat/completions&amp;#96;.\\n    #[default]\\n    Chat,\\n}\\n\\n/// Serializable representation of a provider definition.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, PartialEq)]\\npub struct ModelProviderInfo {\\n    /// Friendly display name.\\n    pub name: String,\\n    /// Base URL for the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.\\n    pub base_url: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n    /// Environment variable that stores the user's API key for this provider.\\n    pub env_key: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Optional instructions to help the user get a valid value for the\\n    /// variable and set it.\\n    pub env_key_instructions: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Value to use with &amp;#96;Authorization: Bearer &amp;lt;token&amp;gt;&amp;#96; header. Use of this\\n    /// config is discouraged in favor of &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; for security reasons, but\\n    /// this may be necessary when using this programmatically.\\n    pub experimental_bearer_token: Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Which wire protocol this provider expects.\\n    #[serde(default)]\\n    pub wire_api: WireApi,\\n\\n    /// Optional query parameters to append to the base URL.\\n    pub query_params: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Additional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where\\n    /// the (key, value) pairs are the header name and value.\\n    pub http_headers: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Optional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where the\\n    /// (key, value) pairs are the header name and _environment variable_ whose\\n    /// value should be used. If the environment variable is not set, or the\\n    /// value is empty, the header will not be included in the request.\\n    pub env_http_headers: Option&amp;lt;HashMap&amp;lt;String, String&amp;gt;&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Maximum number of times to retry a failed HTTP request to this provider.\\n    pub request_max_retries: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Number of times to retry reconnecting a dropped streaming response before failing.\\n    pub stream_max_retries: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Idle timeout (in milliseconds) to wait for activity on a streaming response before treating\\n    /// the connection as lost.\\n    pub stream_idle_timeout_ms: Option&amp;lt;u64&amp;gt;,\\n\\n    /// Does this provider require an OpenAI API Key or ChatGPT login token? If true,\\n    /// user is presented with login screen on first run, and login preference and token/key\\n    /// are stored in auth.json. If false (which is the default), login screen is skipped,\\n    /// and API key (if needed) comes from the \\\"env_key\\\" environment variable.\\n    #[serde(default)]\\n    pub requires_openai_auth: bool,\\n}\\n\\nimpl ModelProviderInfo {\\n    /// Construct a &amp;#96;POST&amp;#96; RequestBuilder for the given URL using the provided\\n    /// [&amp;#96;CodexHttpClient&amp;#96;] applying:\\n    ///   • provider-specific headers (static + env based)\\n    ///   • Bearer auth header when an API key is available.\\n    ///   • Auth token for OAuth.\\n    ///\\n    /// If the provider declares an &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; but the variable is missing/empty, returns an [&amp;#96;Err&amp;#96;] identical to the\\n    /// one produced by [&amp;#96;ModelProviderInfo::api_key&amp;#96;].\\n    pub async fn create_request_builder&amp;lt;'a&amp;gt;(\\n        &amp;amp;'a self,\\n        client: &amp;amp;'a CodexHttpClient,\\n        auth: &amp;amp;Option&amp;lt;CodexAuth&amp;gt;,\\n    ) -&amp;gt; crate::error::Result&amp;lt;CodexRequestBuilder&amp;gt; {\\n        let effective_auth = if let Some(secret_key) = &amp;amp;self.experimental_bearer_token {\\n            Some(CodexAuth::from_api_key(secret_key))\\n        } else {\\n            match self.api_key() {\\n                Ok(Some(key)) =&amp;gt; Some(CodexAuth::from_api_key(&amp;amp;key)),\\n                Ok(None) =&amp;gt; auth.clone(),\\n                Err(err) =&amp;gt; {\\n                    if auth.is_some() {\\n                        auth.clone()\\n                    } else {\\n                        return Err(err);\\n                    }\\n                }\\n            }\\n        };\\n\\n        let url = self.get_full_url(&amp;amp;effective_auth);\\n\\n        let mut builder = client.post(url);\\n\\n        if let Some(auth) = effective_auth.as_ref() {\\n            builder = builder.bearer_auth(auth.get_token().await?);\\n        }\\n\\n        Ok(self.apply_http_headers(builder))\\n    }\\n\\n    fn get_query_string(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        self.query_params\\n            .as_ref()\\n            .map_or_else(String::new, |params| {\\n                let full_params = params\\n                    .iter()\\n                    .map(|(k, v)| format!(\\\"{k}={v}\\\"))\\n                    .collect::&amp;lt;Vec&amp;lt;_&amp;gt;&amp;gt;()\\n                    .join(\\\"&amp;amp;\\\");\\n                format!(\\\"?{full_params}\\\")\\n            })\\n    }\\n\\n    pub(crate) fn get_full_url(&amp;amp;self, auth: &amp;amp;Option&amp;lt;CodexAuth&amp;gt;) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        let default_base_url = if matches!(\\n            auth,\\n            Some(CodexAuth {\\n                mode: AuthMode::ChatGPT,\\n                ..\\n            })\\n        ) {\\n            \\\"https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex\\\"\\n        } else {\\n            \\\"https://api.openai.com/v1\\\"\\n        };\\n        let query_string = self.get_query_string();\\n        let base_url = self\\n            .base_url\\n            .clone()\\n            .unwrap_or(default_base_url.to_string());\\n\\n        match self.wire_api {\\n            WireApi::Responses =&amp;gt; format!(\\\"{base_url}/responses{query_string}\\\"),\\n            WireApi::Chat =&amp;gt; format!(\\\"{base_url}/chat/completions{query_string}\\\"),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    pub(crate) fn is_azure_responses_endpoint(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; bool {\\n        if self.wire_api != WireApi::Responses {\\n            return false;\\n        }\\n\\n        if self.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\\\"azure\\\") {\\n            return true;\\n        }\\n\\n        self.base_url\\n            .as_ref()\\n            .map(|base| matches_azure_responses_base_url(base))\\n            .unwrap_or(false)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Apply provider-specific HTTP headers (both static and environment-based)\\n    /// onto an existing [&amp;#96;CodexRequestBuilder&amp;#96;] and return the updated\\n    /// builder.\\n    fn apply_http_headers(&amp;amp;self, mut builder: CodexRequestBuilder) -&amp;gt; CodexRequestBuilder {\\n        if let Some(extra) = &amp;amp;self.http_headers {\\n            for (k, v) in extra {\\n                builder = builder.header(k, v);\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        if let Some(env_headers) = &amp;amp;self.env_http_headers {\\n            for (header, env_var) in env_headers {\\n                if let Ok(val) = std::env::var(env_var)\\n                    &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !val.trim().is_empty()\\n                {\\n                    builder = builder.header(header, val);\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n        builder\\n    }\\n\\n    /// If &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; is Some, returns the API key for this provider if present\\n    /// (and non-empty) in the environment. If &amp;#96;env_key&amp;#96; is required but\\n    /// cannot be found, returns an error.\\n    pub fn api_key(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; crate::error::Result&amp;lt;Option&amp;lt;String&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n        match &amp;amp;self.env_key {\\n            Some(env_key) =&amp;gt; {\\n                let env_value = std::env::var(env_key);\\n                env_value\\n                    .and_then(|v| {\\n                        if v.trim().is_empty() {\\n                            Err(VarError::NotPresent)\\n                        } else {\\n                            Ok(Some(v))\\n                        }\\n                    })\\n                    .map_err(|_| {\\n                        crate::error::CodexErr::EnvVar(EnvVarError {\\n                            var: env_key.clone(),\\n                            instructions: self.env_key_instructions.clone(),\\n                        })\\n                    })\\n            }\\n            None =&amp;gt; Ok(None),\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective maximum number of request retries for this provider.\\n    pub fn request_max_retries(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; u64 {\\n        self.request_max_retries\\n            .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES)\\n            .min(MAX_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective maximum number of stream reconnection attempts for this provider.\\n    pub fn stream_max_retries(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; u64 {\\n        self.stream_max_retries\\n            .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES)\\n            .min(MAX_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES)\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Effective idle timeout for streaming responses.\\n    pub fn stream_idle_timeout(&amp;amp;self) -&amp;gt; Duration {\\n        self.stream_idle_timeout_ms\\n            .map(Duration::from_millis)\\n            .unwrap_or(Duration::from_millis(DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS))\\n    }\\n    pub fn create_openai_provider() -&amp;gt; ModelProviderInfo {\\n        ModelProviderInfo {\\n            name: \\\"OpenAI\\\".into(),\\n            // Allow users to override the default OpenAI endpoint by\\n            // exporting &amp;#96;OPENAI_BASE_URL&amp;#96;. This is useful when pointing\\n            // Codex at a proxy, mock server, or Azure-style deployment\\n            // without requiring a full TOML override for the built-in\\n            // OpenAI provider.\\n            base_url: std::env::var(\\\"OPENAI_BASE_URL\\\")\\n                .ok()\\n                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()),\\n            env_key: None,\\n            env_key_instructions: None,\\n            experimental_bearer_token: None,\\n            wire_api: WireApi::Responses,\\n            query_params: None,\\n            http_headers: Some(\\n                [(\\\"version\\\".to_string(), env!(\\\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\\\").to_string())]\\n                    .into_iter()\\n                    .collect(),\\n            ),\\n            env_http_headers: Some(\\n                [\\n                    (\\n                        \\\"OpenAI-Organization\\\".to_string(),\\n                        \\\"OPENAI_ORGANIZATION\\\".to_string(),\\n                    ),\\n                    (\\\"OpenAI-Project\\\".to_string(), \\\"OPENAI_PROJECT\\\".to_string()),\\n                ]\\n                .into_iter()\\n                .collect(),\\n            ),\\n            // Use global defaults for retry/timeout unless overridden in config.toml.\\n            request_max_retries: None,\\n            stream_max_retries: None,\\n            stream_idle_timeout_ms: None,\\n            requires_openai_auth: true,\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nconst DEFAULT_OLLAMA_PORT: u32 = 11434;\\n\\npub const BUILT_IN_OSS_MODEL_PROVIDER_ID: &amp;amp;str = \\\"oss\\\";\\n\\n/// Built-in default provider list.\\npub fn built_in_model_providers() -&amp;gt; HashMap&amp;lt;String, ModelProviderInfo&amp;gt; {\\n    use ModelProviderInfo as P;\\n\\n    // We do not want to be in the business of adjucating which third-party\\n    // providers are bundled with Codex CLI, so we only include the OpenAI and\\n    // open source (\\\"oss\\\") providers by default. なんj口調で報告するで。

### いまやったこと
- `codex-common`にOSSユーティリティを公開して依存関係（`codex-lmstudio`/`codex-ollama`）追加。
- `codex-ollama`のデフォルトモデル取得と準備で`OLLAMA_OSS_PROVIDER_ID`に合わせて修正。
- `codex-common::config_summary`をモデルファミリ検出に依存しないシンプル判定へ。
- `exec`に欠けてた`ReviewArgs`構造体を追加、trust関連で`set_project_trust_level`を使うようTUIを修正。
- TUIステータスカードのレートリミット表示を最新`StatusRateLimitData`構造に合わせて再実装。
- `cargo fmt`は実行済み（nightly限定警告だけ出るやつ）。

### ここで詰まったビルド/インストールエラー
`cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --bin codex --force` と `codex-tui` が依存ビルドでコケとる。`cargo build -p codex-cli -p codex-tui --release`も同じ箇所で止まる。

主なエラー（抜粋）:
- `codex-app-server`: `build_turns_from_event_msgs` が lib に再エクスポートされておらず未解決、`ReasoningEffort` の import も `codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort` が正しそう。
- `codex-mcp-server`: `codex_core::orchestration` が無い、`codex_deep_research` クレート未リンクで複数未解決。
- `codex-tui`: `SandboxCommandAssessment` が `codex_protocol::protocol` に見当たらない。
- `exec`: CLIの構造体に `oss_provider` / `add_dir` フィールドが無い、`Command::Review` 変種も欠落。`EventMsg` のパターンが新しいフィールド/variantに追随できておらず多数エラー。
- これらが解決しないと `cargo install` も止まる。

### どう進めるか提案
1) `codex-app-server-protocol` のlibに `pub use protocol::thread_history::build_turns_from_event_msgs;` を追加して解決する。
2) 各 import を新APIに合わせて修正（例: `ReasoningEffort` を `openai_models` から）。
3) MCPサーバーは `codex_deep_research` を依存に追加するか、該当ツールを feature で無効化する方針を決める。
4) `exec`/TUI の`EventMsg`パターンを最新版プロトコルに合わせて `..` でフィールドを無視するか、新variantに対応させる。CLIの不要フィールド/Reviewコマンドをどう扱うか方針要相談。
5) `SandboxCommandAssessment` がプロトコルから消えているっぽいので、代替型または表示文言を決めて差し替え。

この規模になるので、どのAPIを正とするか（プロトコル/コアの現行版か、古い挙動に合わせるか）方針をもらえると助かるで。どう進める？

  "plan": "# ビルドエラー修正プラン（公式最新API整合 + 独自機能維持）\n\n## 現状の問題\n\n&#96;cargo build -p codex-cli -p codex-tui --release&#96; で以下のエラーが発生：\n\n1. **app-server-protocol**: &#96;build_turns_from_event_msgs&#96; が再エクスポートされていない\n2. **app-server**: &#96;ReasoningEffort&#96; のimportパスが古い\n3. **mcp-server**: &#96;codex_core::orchestration&#96; モジュールが公開されていない、&#96;codex_deep_research&#96; クレートが依存に無い\n4. **tui**: &#96;SandboxCommandAssessment&#96; 型が見つからない\n5. **exec**: CLI構造体に &#96;oss_provider&#96;/&#96;add_dir&#96; フィールドが無い、&#96;Command::Review&#96; が無い、&#96;EventMsg&#96; パターンが新しいフィールドに対応していない\n\n## 修正方針\n\n公式の最新APIに合わせつつ、独自機能は維持：\n- &#96;orchestration&#96; モジュールは公開して維持\n- &#96;deep-research&#96; は依存に追加して維持\n- &#96;Review&#96; コマンドは独自機能として維持\n- &#96;EventMsg&#96; の新しいフィールドには &#96;..&#96; で対応\n\n## 修正内容\n\n### 1. app-server-protocol: build_turns_from_event_msgs の再エクスポート\n\n[codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/lib.rs](codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/lib.rs) に追加：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub use protocol::thread_history::build_turns_from_event_msgs;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. app-server: ReasoningEffort のimport修正\n\n[codex-rs/app-server/src/models.rs](codex-rs/app-server/src/models.rs) の4行目を：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. core: orchestration モジュールの公開\n\n[codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs](codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs) に追加：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub mod orchestration;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. mcp-server: deep-research 依存の追加\n\n[codex-rs/mcp-server/Cargo.toml](codex-rs/mcp-server/Cargo.toml) の &#96;[dependencies]&#96; に追加：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\ncodex-deep-research = { path = \"../deep-research\" }\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. protocol: SandboxCommandAssessment の確認と追加\n\n[codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs](codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs) に &#96;SandboxCommandAssessment&#96; 構造体が存在するか確認。存在しない場合は、[codex-rs/core/src/sandboxing/assessment.rs](codex-rs/core/src/sandboxing/assessment.rs) で使用されている定義を protocol に追加するか、core から再エクスポートする。\n\n### 6. exec: CLI構造体の修正\n\n[codex-rs/exec/src/cli.rs](codex-rs/exec/src/cli.rs) の &#96;Cli&#96; 構造体に以下を追加（独自機能として維持）：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n/// OSS provider to use (lmstudio or ollama)\n#[arg(long = \"oss-provider\")]\npub oss_provider: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n/// Additional directories to include in context\n#[arg(long = \"add-dir\", value_name = \"DIR\")]\npub add_dir: Vec&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;Command&#96; enum に &#96;Review&#96; 変種を追加：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n/// Request a code review\nReview(ReviewArgs),\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;ReviewArgs&#96; 構造体を追加（既に [codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs](codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs) に定義済みなので、cli.rs に移動または pub use）。\n\n### 7. exec: EventMsg パターンの更新\n\n[codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_human_output.rs](codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_human_output.rs) で：\n\n- &#96;ErrorEvent&#96; パターンに &#96;codex_error_info&#96; フィールドを追加（&#96;..&#96; で無視可）\n- &#96;StreamErrorEvent&#96; パターンに &#96;codex_error_info&#96; フィールドを追加（&#96;..&#96; で無視可）\n- &#96;PatchApplyBeginEvent&#96; パターンに &#96;turn_id&#96; フィールドを追加（&#96;..&#96; で無視可）\n- &#96;SessionConfiguredEvent&#96; パターンに &#96;model_provider_id&#96;, &#96;approval_policy&#96;, &#96;sandbox_policy&#96;, &#96;cwd&#96; フィールドを追加（&#96;..&#96; で無視可）\n- 削除された &#96;EventMsg&#96; variant（&#96;ConversationPath&#96;, &#96;SubAgentTaskCompleted&#96;, &#96;SubAgentTaskFailed&#96;, &#96;SubAgentProgressUpdate&#96;, &#96;SubAgentMessage&#96;, &#96;SubAgentError&#96;, &#96;SubAgentInfo&#96;）のマッチを削除\n\n### 8. exec: lib.rs の修正\n\n[codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs](codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs) で：\n\n- &#96;oss_provider&#96; と &#96;add_dir&#96; フィールドの使用箇所を確認し、存在しない場合は削除またはデフォルト値で処理\n- &#96;Command::Review&#96; の使用箇所を &#96;cli::Command::Review&#96; に修正\n\n### 9. tui: SandboxCommandAssessment のimport修正\n\n[codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/approval_overlay.rs](codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/approval_overlay.rs) で、&#96;SandboxCommandAssessment&#96; の新しいフィールドは &#96;..&#96; で無視して既存コードを維持",

        "contents": "pub(crate) struct TurnContext {\n    pub(crate) sub_id: String,\n    pub(crate) client: ModelClient,\n    /// The session's current working directory. All relative paths provided by\n    /// the model as well as sandbox policies are resolved against this path\n    /// instead of &#96;std::env::current_dir()&#96;.\n    pub(crate) cwd: PathBuf,\n    pub(crate) developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n    pub(crate) sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n    pub(crate) shell_environment_policy: ShellEnvironmentPolicy,\n    pub(crate) tools_config: ToolsConfig,\n    pub(crate) ghost_snapshot: GhostSnapshotConfig,\n    pub(crate) final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    pub(crate) codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub(crate) tool_call_gate: Arc&lt;ReadinessFlag&gt;,\n    pub(crate) exec_policy: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;ExecPolicy&gt;&gt;,\n    pub(crate) truncation_policy: TruncationPolicy,\n}\n\nimpl TurnContext {\n    pub(crate) fn resolve_path(&amp;self, path: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; PathBuf {\n        path.as_ref()\n            .map(PathBuf::from)\n            .map_or_else(|| self.cwd.clone(), |p| self.cwd.join(p))\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn compact_prompt(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;str {\n        self.compact_prompt\n            .as_deref()\n            .unwrap_or(compact::SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT)\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).",

        "contents": "use codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort as ReasoningEffortConfig;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::CodexErrorInfo;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::InitialHistory;\nuse codex_protocol::user_input::UserInput;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::Readiness;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::ReadinessFlag;\n\n/// The high-level interface to the Codex system.\n/// It operates as a queue pair where you send submissions and receive events.\npub struct Codex {\n    pub(crate) next_id: AtomicU64,\n    pub(crate) tx_sub: Sender&lt;Submission&gt;,\n    pub(crate) rx_event: Receiver&lt;Event&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Wrapper returned by [&#96;Codex::spawn&#96;] containing the spawned [&#96;Codex&#96;],\n/// the submission id for the initial &#96;ConfigureSession&#96; request and the\n/// unique session id.\npub struct CodexSpawnOk {\n    pub codex: Codex,\n    pub conversation_id: ConversationId,\n}\n\npub(crate) const INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID: &amp;str = \"\";\npub(crate) const SUBMISSION_CHANNEL_CAPACITY: usize = 64;\nstatic CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);\n\nfn maybe_push_chat_wire_api_deprecation(\n    config: &amp;Config,\n    post_session_configured_events: &amp;mut Vec&lt;Event&gt;,\n) {\n    if config.model_provider.wire_api != WireApi::Chat {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED\n        .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)\n        .is_err()\n    {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n        id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n        msg: EventMsg::DeprecationNotice(DeprecationNoticeEvent {\n            summary: CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_SUMMARY.to_string(),\n            details: None,\n        }),\n    });\n}\n\nimpl Codex {\n    /// Spawn a new [&#96;Codex&#96;] and initialize the session.",

        "contents": "pub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).\n    provider: ModelProviderInfo,\n\n    /// If not specified, server will use its default model.\n    model: String,\n\n    model_reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffortConfig&gt;,\n    model_reasoning_summary: ReasoningSummaryConfig,\n\n    /// Developer instructions that supplement the base instructions.\n    developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Model instructions that are appended to the base instructions.\n    user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Base instructions override.\n    base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Compact prompt override.\n    compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// When to escalate for approval for execution\n    approval_policy: Constrained&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n    /// How to sandbox commands executed in the system\n    sandbox_policy: Constrained&lt;SandboxPolicy&gt;,\n\n    /// Working directory that should be treated as the *root* of the\n    /// session.         "contents": "use codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort as ReasoningEffortConfig;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::CodexErrorInfo;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::InitialHistory;\nuse codex_protocol::user_input::UserInput;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::Readiness;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::ReadinessFlag;\n\n/// The high-level interface to the Codex system.\n/// It operates as a queue pair where you send submissions and receive events.\npub struct Codex {\n    pub(crate) next_id: AtomicU64,\n    pub(crate) tx_sub: Sender&lt;Submission&gt;,\n    pub(crate) rx_event: Receiver&lt;Event&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Wrapper returned by [&#96;Codex::spawn&#96;] containing the spawned [&#96;Codex&#96;],\n/// the submission id for the initial &#96;ConfigureSession&#96; request and the\n/// unique session id.\npub struct CodexSpawnOk {\n    pub codex: Codex,\n    pub conversation_id: ConversationId,\n}\n\npub(crate) const INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID: &amp;str = \"\";\npub(crate) const SUBMISSION_CHANNEL_CAPACITY: usize = 64;\nstatic CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);\n\nfn maybe_push_chat_wire_api_deprecation(\n    config: &amp;Config,\n    post_session_configured_events: &amp;mut Vec&lt;Event&gt;,\n) {\n    if config.model_provider.wire_api != WireApi::Chat {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED\n        .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)\n        .is_err()\n    {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n        id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n        msg: EventMsg::DeprecationNotice(DeprecationNoticeEvent {\n            summary: CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_SUMMARY.to_string(),\n            details: None,\n        }),\n    });\n}\n\nimpl Codex {\n    /// Spawn a new [&#96;Codex&#96;] and initialize the session.",

        "contents": "---\nname: plan\ndescription: Generate a plan for how an agent should accomplish a complex coding task. Use when a user asks for a plan, and optionally when they want to save, find, read, update, or delete plan files. For full Plan Mode features (approval, execution, budgets), use official commands (&#96;/Plan&#96;, &#96;/approve&#96;, &#96;/Plan export&#96;). For simple markdown files, use $CODEX_HOME/plans (default ~/.codex/plans).\nmetadata:\n  short-description: Generate a plan for a complex task\n---\n\n# Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nDraft structured plans that clarify intent, scope, requirements, action items, testing/validation, and risks.\n\nOptionally, save plans to disk as markdown files with YAML frontmatter and free-form content. When drafting in chat, output only the plan body without frontmatter; add frontmatter only when saving to disk. Only write to the plans folder; do not modify the repository codebase.\n\nThis skill can also be used to draft codebase or system overviews.\n\n## Core rules\n\n- Resolve the plans directory as &#96;$CODEX_HOME/Plans&#96; or &#96;~/.codex/Plans&#96; when &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is not set (matches official Plan Mode CLI).\n- Create the plans directory if it does not exist.\n- Never write to the repo; only read files to understand context.\n- Require frontmatter with **only** &#96;name&#96; and &#96;description&#96; (single-line values) for on-disk plans.\n- When presenting a draft plan in chat, omit frontmatter and start at &#96;# Plan&#96;.\n- Enforce naming rules: short, lower-case, hyphen-delimited; filename must equal &#96;&lt;name&gt;.md&#96;.\n- If a plan is not found, state it clearly and offer to create one.\n- Allow overview-style plans that document flows, architecture, or context without a work checklist.\n\n## Decide the task\n\n1. **Find/list**: discover plans by frontmatter summary; confirm if multiple matches exist.\n2. **Read/use**: validate frontmatter; present summary and full contents.\n3. **Create**: inspect repo read-only; choose plan style (implementation vs overview); draft plan; write to plans directory only.\n4. **Update**: load plan; revise content and/or description; preserve frontmatter keys; overwrite the plan file.\n5. **Delete**: confirm intent, then remove the plan file if asked.",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Resolve the plans directory as &#96;$CODEX_HOME/Plans&#96; or &#96;~/.codex/Plans&#96; when &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is not set (matches official Plan Mode CLI).",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- Create the plans directory if it does not exist.",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Never write to the repo; only read files to understand context.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Require frontmatter with **only** &#96;name&#96; and &#96;description&#96; (single-line values) for on-disk plans.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- When presenting a draft plan in chat, omit frontmatter and start at &#96;# Plan&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- Enforce naming rules: short, lower-case, hyphen-delimited; filename must equal &#96;&lt;name&gt;.md&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- If a plan is not found, state it clearly and offer to create one.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow overview-style plans that document flows, architecture, or context without a work checklist.",

          },
          {

          {

        "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

        "contents": " Result&lt;OrchestratedResult&gt; {\n        // Verify plan is approved\n        if !plan.can_execute() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Plan {} is not approved (state: {})\", plan.id, plan.state);\n        }\n\n        info!(\"Executing plan {} with orchestrator\", plan.id);\n\n        // Emit telemetry: execution started - disabled, module not available\n        // self.emit_telemetry_event(EventType::ExecStart, plan, None).await;\n\n        // Trigger webhook: execution started - disabled, module not available\n        // self.trigger_webhook(\"exec.start\", plan, None).await;\n\n        // Convert plan goal to task description\n        let task = format!(\n            \"{}\\n\\nApproach: {}\\n\\nWork Items: {}\",\n            plan.goal,\n            plan.approach,\n            plan.work_items\n                .iter()\n                .map(|w| format!(\"- {}: {:?}\", w.name, w.files_touched))\n                .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;_&gt;&gt;()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        );\n\n        // Analyze task complexity\n        let analyzer = TaskAnalyzer::new(0.7);\n        let analysis = analyzer.analyze(&amp;task);\n\n        info!(\"Task complexity: {:.2}\", analysis.complexity_score);\n\n        // Execute with auto-orchestrator if beneficial\n        let result = if analysis.complexity_score &gt; 0.7 {\n            self.auto_orchestrator\n                .orchestrate(analysis, task)\n                .await\n                .context(\"Orchestrated execution failed\")?\n        } else {\n            // Simple task, no orchestration needed\n            info!(\"Task complexity below threshold, skipping orchestration\");\n            OrchestratedResult {\n                was_orchestrated: false,\n                agents_used: vec![],\n                execution_summary: \"Task executed without orchestration\".to_string(),\n                agent_results: vec![],\n                total_execution_time_secs: 0.0,\n                task_analysis: analysis,\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Emit telemetry: execution completed - disabled, module not available",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\skills\\assets\\samples\\plan\\SKILL.md",

          "startPosition": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 153
          }
        },
        "contents": "Use the official Plan Mode commands for creating, managing, and exporting plans:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create a plan\ncodex /Plan \"Add request logging\" --mode=orchestrated\n\n# List plans\ncodex /Plan list\n\n# Export a plan\ncodex /Plan export &lt;plan-id&gt; --format=md\n\n# Approve a plan\ncodex /approve &lt;plan-id&gt;\n\n# Reject a plan\ncodex /reject &lt;plan-id&gt; --reason=\"...\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96; and &#96;docs/plan/slash-commands.md&#96; for full documentation.\n\n## Helper Scripts (TypeScript, Optional)\n\nFor simple markdown plan files with frontmatter (saved to &#96;$CODEX_HOME/plans&#96;), TypeScript helpers are available:\n\nCreate a plan file (body only; frontmatter is written for you). Run from the plan skill directory:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnode ./scripts/create_plan.ts \\\n  --name codex-rate-limit-overview \\\n  --description \"Scope and update plan for Codex rate limiting\" \\\n  --body-file /tmp/plan-body.md\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nRead frontmatter summary for a plan (run from the plan skill directory):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnode ./scripts/read_plan_frontmatter.ts ~/.codex/plans/codex-rate-limit-overview.md\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nList plan summaries (optional filter; run from the plan skill directory):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnode ./scripts/list_plans.ts --query \"rate limit\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Note**: These TypeScript helpers work with simple markdown files in &#96;$CODEX_HOME/plans&#96;. For full Plan Mode features (approval, execution, budgets), use the official commands above.\n\n## Plan file format\n\nUse one of the structures below for the plan body. When drafting, output only the body (no frontmatter). When saving, prepend this frontmatter:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n---\nname: &lt;plan-name&gt;\ndescription: &lt;1-line summary&gt;\n---\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Implementation plan body template\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n# Plan\n\n&lt;1-3 sentences: intent, scope, and approach.&gt;\n\n## Requirements\n- &lt;Requirement 1&gt;\n- &lt;Requirement 2&gt;\n\n## Scope\n- In:\n- Out:\n\n## Files and entry points\n- &lt;File/module/entry point 1&gt;\n- &lt;File/module/entry point 2&gt;\n\n## Data model / API changes\n- &lt;If applicable, describe schema or contract changes&gt;\n\n## Action items\n[ ] &lt;Step 1&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 2&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 3&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 4&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 5&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 6&gt;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "Use the official Plan Mode commands for creating, managing, and exporting plans:",

            "text": "# Create a plan",

          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add request logging\" --mode=orchestrated",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "# List plans",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan list",
            "lineNumber": 72

          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "# Export a plan",
            "lineNumber": 74

          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export &lt;plan-id&gt; --format=md",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "See &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96; and &#96;docs/plan/slash-commands.md&#96; for full documentation.",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "## Helper Scripts (TypeScript, Optional)",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "For simple markdown plan files with frontmatter (saved to &#96;$CODEX_HOME/plans&#96;), TypeScript helpers are available:",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a plan file (body only; frontmatter is written for you). Run from the plan skill directory:",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "node ./scripts/create_plan.ts \\",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "  --name codex-rate-limit-overview \\",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "  --description \"Scope and update plan for Codex rate limiting\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "  --body-file /tmp/plan-body.md",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "Read frontmatter summary for a plan (run from the plan skill directory):",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "node ./scripts/read_plan_frontmatter.ts ~/.codex/plans/codex-rate-limit-overview.md",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "List plan summaries (optional filter; run from the plan skill directory):",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "node ./scripts/list_plans.ts --query \"rate limit\"",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "**Note**: These TypeScript helpers work with simple markdown files in &#96;$CODEX_HOME/plans&#96;. For full Plan Mode features (approval, execution, budgets), use the official commands above.",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "## Plan file format",

        "contents": "//! Collaboration store for sharing context between sub-agents.\n//!\n//! Provides a thread-safe shared memory store that allows sub-agents to\n//! communicate and share results during parallel execution.\n\nuse super::parallel_execution::AgentResult;\nuse super::parallel_execution::AgentStatus;\nuse dashmap::DashMap;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse serde_json::Value;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n/// Message passed between agents.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentMessage {\n    /// Sender agent name\n    pub from: String,\n    /// Recipient agent name (or \"broadcast\" for all)\n    pub to: String,\n    /// Message content\n    pub content: Value,\n    /// Timestamp\n    pub timestamp: SystemTime,\n    /// Message priority (higher = more urgent)\n    pub priority: u8,\n}\n\n/// Shared store for agent collaboration during orchestrated execution.\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct CollaborationStore {\n    /// Shared context data (key-value store)\n    shared_context: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Value&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Agent execution results\n    agent_results: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, AgentResult&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Task-level metadata\n    task_metadata: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Value&gt;&gt;,\n\n    /// Message queue for inter-agent communication\n    message_queue: Arc&lt;DashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;AgentMessage&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl CollaborationStore {\n    /// Create a new collaboration store.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          },

        "contents": "4. **Update**: load plan; revise content and/or description; preserve frontmatter keys; overwrite the plan file.\n5. **Delete**: confirm intent, then remove the plan file if asked.\n\n## Plan discovery\n\n- Use official Plan Mode commands: &#96;codex /Plan export &lt;plan-id&gt;&#96; to view plans\n- For listing plans, use &#96;codex /Plan list&#96; (CLI) or browse in the TUI/GUI\n- Optional: Use &#96;scripts/list_plans.ts&#96; for quick frontmatter summaries (TypeScript helper)\n- Optional: Use &#96;scripts/read_plan_frontmatter.ts&#96; to validate a specific plan (TypeScript helper)\n- If name mismatches filename or frontmatter is missing fields, call it out and ask whether to fix.\n\n## Plan creation workflow\n\n1. Scan context quickly: read README.md and obvious docs (docs/, CONTRIBUTING.md, ARCHITECTURE.md); skim likely touched files; identify constraints (language, frameworks, CI/test commands, deployment).\n2. Ask follow-ups only if blocked: at most 1-2 questions, prefer multiple-choice. If unsure but not blocked, state assumptions and proceed.\n3. Identify scope, constraints, and data model/API implications (or capture existing behavior for an overview).\n4. Draft either an ordered implementation plan or a structured overview plan with diagrams/notes as needed.\n5. Immediately output the plan body only (no frontmatter), then ask the user if they want to 1. Make changes, 2. Implement it, 3. Save it.\n6. If the user wants to save it:\n   - **Preferred**: Use official Plan Mode: &#96;codex /Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\"&#96; to create a plan (saves to &#96;~/.codex/Plans&#96; or configured directory)\n   - **Alternative**: Use TypeScript helper &#96;scripts/create_plan.ts&#96; to save to &#96;$CODEX_HOME/plans&#96; (for simple markdown files with frontmatter)\n\n\n## Plan update workflow\n\n- Re-read the plan and related code/docs before updating.\n- Keep the plan name stable unless the user explicitly wants a rename.\n- If renaming, update both frontmatter &#96;name&#96; and filename together.\n\n## Official Plan Mode Commands (Preferred)\n\nUse the official Plan Mode commands for creating, managing, and exporting plans:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create a plan\ncodex /Plan \"Add request logging\" --mode=orchestrated",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n/**\n * Create or overwrite a plan markdown file in $CODEX_HOME/plans.\n */\n\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\nimport { getPlansDir, validatePlanName } from './plan_utils.js';\n\nconst DEFAULT_TEMPLATE = &#96;# Plan\n\n&lt;1-3 sentences: intent, scope, and approach.&gt;\n\n## Requirements\n- &lt;Requirement 1&gt;\n- &lt;Requirement 2&gt;\n\n## Scope\n- In:\n- Out:\n\n## Files and entry points\n- &lt;File/module/entry point 1&gt;\n- &lt;File/module/entry point 2&gt;\n\n## Data model / API changes\n- &lt;If applicable, describe schema or contract changes&gt;\n\n## Action items\n[ ] &lt;Step 1&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 2&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 3&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 4&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 5&gt;\n[ ] &lt;Step 6&gt;\n\n## Testing and validation\n- &lt;Tests, commands, or validation steps&gt;\n\n## Risks and edge cases\n- &lt;Risk 1&gt;\n- &lt;Risk 2&gt;\n\n## Open questions\n- &lt;Question 1&gt;\n- &lt;Question 2&gt;\n&#96;;\n\nfunction readBody(args: {\n  template?: boolean;\n  bodyFile?: string;\n}): string | null {\n  if (args.template) {\n    return DEFAULT_TEMPLATE;\n  }\n  if (args.bodyFile) {\n    return fs.readFileSync(args.bodyFile, 'utf-8');\n  }\n  // Check if stdin is available (non-interactive)\n  if (!process.stdin.isTTY) {\n    return fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf-8');\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nfunction main(): number {\n  const args:\n;\n}",

        "contents": "use codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort as ReasoningEffortConfig;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::CodexErrorInfo;\nuse codex_protocol::protocol::InitialHistory;\nuse codex_protocol::user_input::UserInput;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::Readiness;\nuse codex_utils_readiness::ReadinessFlag;\n\n/// The high-level interface to the Codex system.\n/// It operates as a queue pair where you send submissions and receive events.\npub struct Codex {\n    pub(crate) next_id: AtomicU64,\n    pub(crate) tx_sub: Sender&lt;Submission&gt;,\n    pub(crate) rx_event: Receiver&lt;Event&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Wrapper returned by [&#96;Codex::spawn&#96;] containing the spawned [&#96;Codex&#96;],\n/// the submission id for the initial &#96;ConfigureSession&#96; request and the\n/// unique session id.\npub struct CodexSpawnOk {\n    pub codex: Codex,\n    pub conversation_id: ConversationId,\n}\n\npub(crate) const INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID: &amp;str = \"\";\npub(crate) const SUBMISSION_CHANNEL_CAPACITY: usize = 64;\nstatic CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);\n\nfn maybe_push_chat_wire_api_deprecation(\n    config: &amp;Config,\n    post_session_configured_events: &amp;mut Vec&lt;Event&gt;,\n) {\n    if config.model_provider.wire_api != WireApi::Chat {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_EMITTED\n        .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)\n        .is_err()\n    {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n        id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n        msg: EventMsg::DeprecationNotice(DeprecationNoticeEvent {\n            summary: CHAT_WIRE_API_DEPRECATION_SUMMARY.to_string(),\n            details: None,\n        }),\n    });\n}\n\nimpl Codex {\n    /// Spawn a new [&#96;Codex&#96;] and initialize the session.",

        "contents": "    async fn generate_execution_plan(\n        &amp;self,\n        analysis: &amp;TaskAnalysis,\n        original_goal: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecutionPlan&gt; {\n        // For now, create a simple plan based on recommended agents\n        // In full implementation, this would call codex-supervisor MCP tool\n\n        let mut tasks = Vec::new();\n\n        for (idx, agent) in analysis.recommended_agents.iter().enumerate() {\n            let description = if idx &lt; analysis.subtasks.len() {\n                analysis.subtasks[idx].clone()\n            } else {\n                format!(\"Execute {agent} for: {original_goal}\")\n            };\n\n            tasks.push(PlannedTask {\n                id: idx + 1,\n                description,\n                agent: agent.clone(),\n                status: \"pending\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        Ok(ExecutionPlan {\n            goal: original_goal.to_string(),\n            tasks,\n            strategy: \"parallel\".to_string(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Execute agents from the execution plan.\n    async fn execute_agents_from_plan(\n        &amp;self,\n        plan: &amp;ExecutionPlan",

        "contents": "pub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).\n    provider: ModelProviderInfo,\n\n    /// If not specified, server will use its default model.\n    model: String,\n\n    model_reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffortConfig&gt;,\n    model_reasoning_summary: ReasoningSummaryConfig,\n\n    /// Developer instructions that supplement the base instructions.\n    developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Model instructions that are appended to the base instructions.\n    user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Base instructions override.\n    base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Compact prompt override.\n    compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// When to escalate for approval for execution\n    approval_policy: Constrained&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n    /// How to sandbox commands executed in the system\n    sandbox_policy: Constrained&lt;SandboxPolicy&gt;,\n\n    /// Working directory that should be treated as the *root* of the\n    /// session.         "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

        "contents": "pub enum ExecutionStrategy {\n    /// Execute all tasks in parallel for maximum speed\n    Parallel,\n    /// Execute tasks sequentially for dependencies\n    Sequential,\n    /// Hybrid: parallel where possible, sequential where needed\n    Hybrid,\n}\n\n/// Autonomous orchestrator that coordinates sub-agents transparently.\npub struct AutoOrchestrator {\n    /// Agent runtime for executing sub-agents\n    runtime: Arc&lt;AgentRuntime&gt;,\n\n    /// Collaboration store for agent communication\n    collaboration_store: Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt;,\n\n    /// Conflict resolver for file edits\n    conflict_resolver: Arc&lt;ConflictResolver&gt;,\n\n    /// Workspace directory\n    workspace_dir: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl AutoOrchestrator {\n    /// Create a new auto-orchestrator.\n    pub fn new(\n        runtime: Arc&lt;AgentRuntime&gt;,\n        collaboration_store: Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt;,\n        workspace_dir: std::path::PathBuf,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self::with_merge_strategy(\n            runtime,\n            collaboration_store,\n            workspace_dir,\n            MergeStrategy::Sequential,\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new auto-orchestrator with a specific merge strategy.\n    pub fn with_merge_strategy(\n        runtime: Arc&lt;AgentRuntime&gt;,\n        collaboration_store: Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt;,\n        workspace_dir: std::path::PathBuf,\n        merge_strategy: MergeStrategy,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            runtime,\n            collaboration_store,\n            conflict_resolver: Arc::new(ConflictResolver::new(merge_strategy)),\n            workspace_dir,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get a reference to the conflict resolver.\n    pub fn conflict_resolver(&amp;self) -&gt; Arc&lt;ConflictResolver&gt; {\n        self.conflict_resolver.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Orchestrate task execution based on analysis.\n    pub async fn orchestrate(\n        &amp;self,\n        analysis: TaskAnalysis,",

        "contents": ",\n}\n\nimpl OtelManager {\n    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\n    pub fn new(\n        conversation_id: ConversationId,\n        model: &amp;str,\n        slug: &amp;str,\n        account_id: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        account_email: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        auth_mode: Option&lt;AuthMode&gt;,\n        log_user_prompts: bool,\n        terminal_type: String,\n        session_source: SessionSource,\n    ) -&gt; OtelManager {\n        let session_span = trace_span!(\"new_session\", conversation_id = %conversation_id, session_source = %session_source);\n\n        if let Some(context) = traceparent_context_from_env() {\n            session_span.set_parent(context);\n        }\n\n        Self {\n            metadata: OtelEventMetadata {\n                conversation_id,\n                auth_mode: auth_mode.map(|m| m.to_string()),\n                account_id,\n                account_email,\n                model: model.to_owned(),\n                slug: slug.to_owned(),\n                log_user_prompts,\n                app_version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"),\n                terminal_type,\n            },\n            session_span,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_model(&amp;self, model: &amp;str, slug: &amp;str) -&gt; Self {\n        let mut manager = self.clone();\n        manager.metadata.model = model.to_owned();\n        manager.metadata.slug = slug.to_owned();\n        manager\n    }\n\n    pub fn current_span(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;Span {\n        &amp;self.session_span\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_responses(&amp;self, handle_responses_span: &amp;Span,",

        "contents": "---\n\n#### 5.3. OtelEventManager::new() の引数追加（4箇所）\n\n**修正前**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet otel_manager = OtelEventManager::new();\nlet conversation_id = ConversationId(Uuid::new_v4());\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**修正後**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet conversation_id = ConversationId(Uuid::new_v4());\nlet otel_manager = OtelEventManager::new(\n    conversation_id,\n    \"test-model\",\n    \"test\",\n    None,\n    None,\n    false,\n    \"test\".to_string(),\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**理由**: &#96;OtelEventManager::new()&#96; の署名が以下のように変更されていた：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub fn new(\n    conversation_id: ConversationId,\n    model: &amp;str,\n    slug: &amp;str,\n    account_id: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    auth_mode: Option&lt;AuthMode&gt;,\n    log_user_prompts: bool,\n    terminal_type: String,\n) -&gt; OtelEventManager\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 6. 監査ログの &#96;.await&#96; 追加（2箇所）\n\n**修正前**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(...));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**修正後**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(...))\n    .await;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**理由**: &#96;log_audit_event&#96; が非同期関数のため、&#96;.await&#96; が必要\n\n---\n\n## 🏗️ ビルド手順\n\n### Phase 1: プロセス停止\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nGet-Process cargo,rustc,rust-analyzer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force\nStart-Sleep -Seconds 2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**: ✅ 全プロセス停止完了\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: cargo clean\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd codex-rs\ncargo clean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRemoved 10737 files, 3.3GiB total\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Phase 3: devビルド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo build -p codex-cli 2&gt;&amp;1 | Tee-Object -FilePath \"..\\build-clean-dev.log\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n- ⏱️ **ビルド時間**: 3分55秒\n- ⚠️ **警告**: 13件（&#96;codex-core&#96;: 11件、&#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;: 2件）\n- ✅ **ステータス**: &#96;Finished \\&#96;dev\\&#96; profile [unoptimized + debuginfo]&#96;\n- 📦 **出力**: &#96;target\\debug\\codex.exe&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Phase 4: グローバルインストール\n\n#### 試行1: cargo install\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo install --path cli --force\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**: ❌ エラー（&#96;アクセスが拒否されました。 (os error 5)&#96;）\n\n**原因**: 既存の &#96;codex.exe&#96; が使用中だった\n\n---",

        "contents": "---\n\n#### 5.3. OtelEventManager::new() の引数追加（4箇所）\n\n**修正前**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet otel_manager = OtelEventManager::new();\nlet conversation_id = ConversationId(Uuid::new_v4());\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**修正後**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet conversation_id = ConversationId(Uuid::new_v4());\nlet otel_manager = OtelEventManager::new(\n    conversation_id,\n    \"test-model\",\n    \"test\",\n    None,\n    None,\n    false,\n    \"test\".to_string(),\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**理由**: &#96;OtelEventManager::new()&#96; の署名が以下のように変更されていた：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub fn new(\n    conversation_id: ConversationId,\n    model: &amp;str,\n    slug: &amp;str,\n    account_id: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    auth_mode: Option&lt;AuthMode&gt;,\n    log_user_prompts: bool,\n    terminal_type: String,\n) -&gt; OtelEventManager\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 6. 監査ログの &#96;.await&#96; 追加（2箇所）\n\n**修正前**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(...));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**修正後**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(...))\n    .await;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**理由**: &#96;log_audit_event&#96; が非同期関数のため、&#96;.await&#96; が必要\n\n---\n\n## 🏗️ ビルド手順\n\n### Phase 1: プロセス停止\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nGet-Process cargo,rustc,rust-analyzer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force\nStart-Sleep -Seconds 2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**: ✅ 全プロセス停止完了\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: cargo clean\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd codex-rs\ncargo clean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRemoved 10737 files, 3.3GiB total\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Phase 3: devビルド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo build -p codex-cli 2&gt;&amp;1 | Tee-Object -FilePath \"..\\build-clean-dev.log\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n- ⏱️ **ビルド時間**: 3分55秒\n- ⚠️ **警告**: 13件（&#96;codex-core&#96;: 11件、&#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;: 2件）\n- ✅ **ステータス**: &#96;Finished \\&#96;dev\\&#96; が使用中だった\n\n---",

        "contents": "---\n\n#### 5.3. が使用中だった\n\n---",
